items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I went across the street and worked with Louis Armstrong and Earl.

ctx.x: I got the fiddle here, but I was selling high-fi equipment in the daytime. I don't have time to practice. I never heard it there. Earl's been after me ever since I've been here to bring it in there. Why don't you? Uh-huh.
Get in shape. Play it, don't you?
